Hi all — thanks for including me. I reviewed the draft rubric and manager notes. A few quick pointers for the calibration facilitation: 

- Start with a 5-minute calibration example (one anonymized case) to align on language.
- Use the three-bucket rubric (Scope / Execution / Leadership) and keep concrete evidence prompts (what did they ship / who did they influence / outcomes).
- For promotion cases: ensure managers include stakeholder testimonials (email snippets or slack threads) and product metrics where possible — it speeds HR reviews.

I uploaded a short facilitation checklist to your Drive and will join the Thu session. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B-example-calibration-playbook

Best,
Emma Reid
Senior Consultant, PeoplePartners
